genotype_to_drug_rule: Within Klebsiella pneumoniae species complex, calls R when any mapped Kleborate resistance column contains a non-'-' determinant; absent columns yield no_call and non-KpSC species are unsupported.

i_handling.description: Kleborate reports AMR locus/mutation presence strings or '-' without an I category; any I token is counted separately and never mapped to S.
